const rub=n=>n==null?'Цена уточняется':new Intl.NumberFormat('ru-RU').format(n)+' ₽';

function sectionHead(k,t,hash,label){return `<div class="section-head"><div><p class="eyebrow">${k}</p><h2 class="section-title">${t}</h2></div>${hash?`<a href="${hash}">${label} →</a>`:''}</div>`}
